tools.name: search_community_apps
tools.description: Product data tool: search and browse the Mana community's published iPhone creations (games, tools, utilities created by users). Returns app titles, handles, creators, slugs, and pagination info.

tools.name: get_popular_tags
tools.description: Product data tool: list the popular tags used to categorise Mana community creations, with frequency counts.

tools.name: get_public_share
tools.description: Product data tool: fetch either a Mana creator's public profile or one published Mana creation by handle and optional slug, including machine-readable rights.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_public_share" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Product data tool: fetch either a Mana creator's public profile or one published Mana creation by handle and optional slug." → after: "Product data tool: fetch either a Mana creator's public profile or one published Mana creation by handle and optional slug, including machine-readable rights."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
